children: Demand for Canon Marketing Japan's security software is likely still growing, SMBC Nikko Securities analysts say in a research report. This demand appears strong as Japan's government is set to launch a new framework to assess security measures for supply chains, the analysts note. As the distributor and support partner for cybersecurity and endpoint protection software in Japan captures security software demand, its mid-tier customer base is expected to grow and cross-selling will probably increase over the medium-term. The brokerage raises the stock's target price to 4,600 yen from Y4,250 with unchanged outperform rating. Shares are 0.6% lower at Y3,968. (ronnie.harui@wsj.com)
